summaries.Good news: Communities are showing up for each other in meaningful ways—from a Texas town buying a car for a woman who's fed thousands at Thanksgiving, to forest restoration training spreading across Africa, to a baby given weeks to live now cancer-free. Real human kindness and breakthrough recoveries are happening.
summaries.Ideas: AI is reshaping how we work, think, and communicate—from companies glosslighting us with misleading terminology, to workers hoarding AI knowledge to stay competitive, to the next generation of bionic hands letting people feel again. The gap between AI hype and reality is becoming impossible to ignore.
summaries.Technology: AI agents are proliferating across every platform (from coding to video editing to memory management), while hardware innovation continues with everything from robot bins in Tokyo to Porsche's electric Boxster to breakthrough light-sorting chips. The infrastructure wars are heating up as SpaceX gets FCC approval for a million-satellite orbital data center constellation.
summaries.Design: Europe's largest museum opened in a repurposed 1930s Citroën garage in Brussels, Visa got a thoughtful brand refresh, and influential architects like BC Architects & Studies and Carlo Ratti are pushing the field forward with AI-assisted curation and forward-looking landmark buildings. Design is proving it can tackle both beauty and planetary responsibility.
